pictures.name: AW1-Country-Road
pictures.prompt: Ancient Greece, a rural dirt road between olive groves and stone walls after a rainstorm, puddles shining. A sturdy bearded farmer in a rough wool tunic and a brimmed straw hat walks beside two brown oxen pulling a wooden cart loaded with sacks. Clearing sky, gold late-afternoon light, deep blue cloud shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
